study: Future 20 ms Ia spike counts in archived passive stretch records
scope: Use only the registered healthy development members of filename groups 0, 1, 4 in the source owner's validated windows. Leave every trial of one entire prefix out per fold. Reserve 5 remains unopened. Filename prefixes have no verified one-to-one mapping to animals.
tokens_detail: Five consecutive completed 20 ms bins, oldest first. Force and actuator position in native units, slopes are (last minus first native measurement) / corresponding elapsed seconds inside each bin. Counts from archived event timestamps, left-closed/right-open bins. No reciprocal-interval or target-bin predictors.
label: Detected spike count in the immediately following 20 ms. Predictions are expected counts, in spikes per 20 ms.
normalization: Training fold only, float64 feature mean and population variance equally weighted by afferent then trial then window then bin across the five inputs. Standard-deviation floor 1e-6. Clip normalized tokens to [-10, 10], then zero inactive channels. Identical preprocessing in fit and deployment.
architecture: Five positions, 16-dimensional affine input with learned positions, pre-layernorm 2-head scaled dot-product self-attention within completed history, residual, pre-layernorm 16-32-16 ReLU feedforward residual, final layernorm of last position, one affine softplus output plus 1e-6. No dropout or causal mask within past input. All branches have identical parameterization and starting state for a given seed.
fit: Train exactly 240 AdamW (learning_rate=.002, betas .9/.999, eps=1e-8, weight_decay=.001) steps, batch=80, gradient norm clipped at 1, average Poisson negative log-likelihood without constant (lambda - target*log(lambda)). No warm start, early stopping, tuning or weighting by held results. Same batch-index plan per fold and seed across branches. Draw member uniformly, trial uniformly within member, window uniformly within trial, with replacement. Seeds for weights and samples fixed. No held events in weights or scalers.
control: For primary all-signal model in each held fold, only change the four mechanics features using an identically indexed window of the same afferent/trial with target bin_index exactly 5 earlier. Their historical intervals are disjoint. Keep the original spike history, cutoff and observed count. Missing earlier rows are excluded in both sides of this matched contrast. Do not wrap, cross trials or fill unavailable controls.
evaluation: Report source-eligible OOF rates for each seed and branch, matched control rates; seeds are repeated fits. Score owner independently applies predeclared comparison, aggregation, constant/history/regularized baselines, deviance, physical errors, calibration and uncertainty. Descriptive held prefix and afferent predictions only. Separate intact/shifted control inference never serves as model selection.
export: Fixed seed 1641 and prefix-0-held all branch for portable replay of the previously sourced aff015 example; preserve all weights, normalizers and OOF ids. The sample was seen during earlier source reconnaissance but excluded from every fit and scaler in this fold. Forecast offline only. No prospective, causal, animal-independent or cross-species/human claim.
compute: Before full fit compare fixed training prefix, same records, sampler, initialization and float32 updates on CPU1, CPU2 and available ROCm. Use median/total stage wall time and numerical parity versus CPU1 (max absolute expected-count difference <= .001 across fixed validation probe). Fall back to CPU1 for failed or slower candidates. Torch owns CPU SIMD and GPU workgroup geometry. No mixed precision or TF32. One process, one inter-op and no nested loader pool. Keep throughput decisions separate from evidence on biological prediction.
refit: Exact deterministic re-fit of the fixed 1641/prefix0/all branch for fixture and checkpoint reproduction. Other 44 fits are archived and can be rebuilt on demand.
